sentences.text:
Author: P Gopinath
Bench: P Gopinath

WP(C) No.696/2023 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE GOPINATH P.
 Monday, the 7th day of August 2023 / 16th Sravana, 1945  WP(C) NO. 696 OF 2023(J)
 PETITIONER:
 JOE MICHAEL, AGED 48 YEARS, S/O. LATE MICHAEL, 257, 15TH CROSS ROAD,
 GIRINAGAR, KADAVANTHRA, ERNAKULAM, PIN - 682020  RESPONDENTS:

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. THE STATE OF KERALA, REPRESENTED BY THE DISTRICT COLLECTOR, CIVIL  STATION, ALAPPUZHA, PIN - 688001

AND 2 OTHERS  Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to stay all proceedings pursuant on Ext.P7 communication of the  2nd respondent, and to direct the 1st respondent to return possession of  the acquired properties to the petitioner until such time as the  requirements of S.94 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in  Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been  actually complied with, pending disposal of the above Writ Petition.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in  Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this court's order dated  07-07-2023 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.ANIL SIVARAMAN, RAJI  VINCENT & JOTHISHA K.A., Advocates for the petitioner, GOVERNMENT PLEADER  for respondents 1 & 2 and of SMT. RASHMITA RAMACHANDRAN, STANDING COUNSEL  for respondent 3, the court passed the following:-
 ORDER Interim order is extended by six weeks.
Sd/- GOPINATH P. JUDGE 07-08-2023 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Joe Michael vs State Of Kerala on 7 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105698685/
